nom: IT Cosmetics Bye Bye Redness Serum

segments.oily: One reviewer in her forties with extremely oily skin reports the serum is not greasy and calms the redness and inflammation that oil seemed to worsen.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe red, dry, flaky patches around the nose and lips being hydrated and calmed, with several noting good moisture during cold winter weather.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report reduced redness on cheeks/nose and one notes no effect on redness despite liking the feel; one combination-skin reviewer saw no results at all.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers most consistently report reduced redness and no new irritation or breakouts, describing the serum as gentle, calming and non-pilling under makeup, though a few sensitive-skin users saw a reaction or no benefit.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her forties describes the serum as effective for redness and inflammation and appreciates its anti-aging carnosine content.

concerns.aging: Only one reviewer mentions aging directly, praising the inclusion of carnosine as an anti-aging ingredient alongside redness relief.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers report added hydration and moisture, especially in winter or with dry patches, describing the serum as lightweight yet moisturizing; one wished for more moisturizing effect.
concerns.redness: The large majority of reviewers, including many with rosacea, report visible reduction in redness, blotchiness and flushing, often within days to a few weeks; however a notable minority (including several with rosacea) report no change at all or even worsened redness and irritation.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe the serum as helping a damaged or irritated skin barrier feel calmer and less reactive after use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports reduced redness specifically around old acne marks and scars, helping even out skin tone in those areas.
concerns.blemishes: A couple of reviewers with acne-prone or cystic acne skin report the serum did not cause new breakouts and one felt it reduced inflamed acne, but this is not a primary focus of most reviews.
concerns.oiliness: Only one reviewer addresses oiliness, noting her very oily skin type and that the serum did not feel greasy despite this.

aspects.libelle: Pills or slides under makeup or other products
Requires weeks of consistent use to see results
Causes tingling or reaction on application
Good value, small amount goes a long way

extraits.texte: As a person with rosacea (without bumps) I was excited to try this serum, but have been severely disappointed. After application on cleansed skin, it causes tingling which I know is usually a bad sign but I persevered anyway. I used it as directed for about a week with my normal routine. Not only did I experience no improvement in my redness, but it's actually worse and my skin is so irritated! I am so disappointed, don't waste your time and money!

This is BY FAR the best product I have ever used. It has almost completely obliterated my rosacea. I am a little bit different than most rosacea sufferers because my skin is EXTREMELY oily for a woman in her forties, and the oil seemed to make the redness and inflammation worse. This product is not at all greasy and has really calmed my skin down a lot. I will be devastated if this product ever gets discontinued. It also is one of the few products available that contains carnosine, which is so powerful for anti-aging.

I have roscea and the redness i experience isnt on the extreme end, but it still happens. I also have sensitive, dry acne prone skin all in which makes it even more difficult to find products that work for me especially for improving my roscea. Found this product and I started with just wearing in the am and it works amazing. Very conditioning for my dry skin but also helps with the redness. Ive experienced not sensitivity to this product either its very gentle and if you're experiencing a roscea flare it helps calm the skin in my experience. Highly recommend!

I have been using this it cosmetics bye bye redness serum for over a month and I can see a big difference. I have lots of redness from minor acne scars on my cheeks. This product has really helped reduce the redness on those areas. My skin looks brighter and clearer

The IT Cosmetics Bye Bye Redness Serum is a great product for facial redness! I recieved this product for free from Bzzagent in exchange for my honest opinion. I normally have dry skin that can often experience that annoying redness. While trying the serum, I noticed the serum was lightweight and offered good hydration during Wisconsin's cold winter. It terms of correcting the redness in my skin, to my surprise, I noticed the redness in my face started to fade within about 2 weeks of using the serum. The color of the serum helps to offset the redness in my skin. I've been using IT Cosmetics products for over 4 years, and they are all great trust worthy products that perform as promised. All in all, in my experience, this is a great light weight serum that does what it says. I would recommend this product to friends and family that struggle with facial redness.

I am mid-30s with combo skin, like rosacea on cheeks, and live in a hot, humid location. I have used quite a few things that say it gets rid of redness and its never worked. Either nothing happens or I'm left with this dingy white/green residue on my face. Not this! This product is amazing. My redness was gone within days. On top of that, the serum was a wonderful consistency. Just a pump or so is enough so it will go a long way. Putting it on, it felt like a velvety oatmeal, so very calming, but it dries so light I forgot I even had it on. Absolutely love this!

I really wanted to love this serum for many reasons. It went on easily, it felt lovely, moisturized very well, made my skin look great right away. Then I woke up in the middle of the night to red bumps all over my entire face. For reference, I do have sensitive skin.
